Following the fall of Fort Meru during the new Arachnid offensive, Terran Command has vowed to take back the initiative and recover all lost territory.

A massive fleet of dropships has gathered and is now en route to carry our troopers back into the battlefield.

Come in, anybody. Any one? It’s a massacre out there.
Plasma bugs were waiting for us, blew our shuttles out of the sky.
Rocket troopers are down! We're done for.
Use the rocket launchers and ammo crates from the dropship. You'll need their extra reach.
Comms are shot to hell, we can't get through to request pickup.
Our best chance is to fight our way west to a local relay station. From there we should be able to contact Fleet
Glad to hear your voice, colonel, I knew you’d pull through.
I always do.
What’s your status? Command’s upset the advance is behind schedule.
There’s not going to be any advance! Do they have any idea what happened down here?
Intel is still sketchy. Only a few of the drop teams have radioed us so far.
Those might be the only ones left!
It's bad out there. We need pick up.
That's a no-go on pick up. Plasma bugs to the South of your position are making the approach too hot for shuttles. You take them out, we'll find some pilots crazy enough to come get you.
Roger that. Lets go take out those plasma bugs.
Looks like we've out stayed our welcome. Time to leave this party. Where are those shuttles?
Pick up is a no go. All hell's breaking loose in orbit, at least two ships have taken direct hits. You're going to have to try and make it out on foot.
This just gets better and better. Our only chance is to split into small groups, stay low and move fast. That way least some of us should see tomorrow.
Command has ordered a general retreat. Get your people ready for evacuation
What about the other squads?
A lot of them are not going to make it. We have their locations, but heavy plasma bug fire means Command can’t risk the shuttles to make pick up. Your people are the lucky ones...
Negative, we’re not leaving. The MI leaves no trooper behind. Send over the coordinates of those plasma bugs. We’ll take em out and clear a path for the shuttles.
That's a big call to make on your own, colonel. There's a hell of a lotta bugs guarding them. If this goes wrong, it's on your head.
Wouldn’t have it any other way.
We've reached some of the survivors.
We've got a distress call coming in from another group of survivors. If you can get to them, we could sure use their help.
Come on you apes, join a squad and get back into action!
You're with us now!
Intel estimates must have been wrong. The Bugs are already here.
That horde of bugs is here. Destroy the last Plasmas and get out!
You're going to have to pick up the pace. We've got bug readings off the dial closing on your location
Great, as if we needed the extra motivation.
Inform Command that we're looking at a total loss.
More survivors up ahead!
Take cover! Plasma strike incoming!
Godammnit! How many more people are we going to lose today?
